proposed_experiment.location: new study-private Python wrapper and separately named probe only; do not patch production controller or original validation contracts
proposed_experiment.preserve_core: Call original core exactly once with identical measured/reference/force/wrench/rotation inputs. Copy its output and modify only returned Cartesian translation after step. Never call core.reset/rebase/track_output to inject compensation.
proposed_experiment.equation: e=reference_position-measured_position; e_t=e-n*(e dot n); requested=clip_norm(0.3*e_t,1.5mm); c=project_tangent(c+(1-exp(-dt/.08))*(requested-c)); output_xyz=core_output_xyz+c. Output orientation and mass/damping/stiffness remain original.
proposed_experiment.coordinates: Use instantaneous TCP normal n=rotation[:,2], not unqualified baseXY. BaseXY may contain a normal component if TCP tilts. Validate n is finite and unit length.

gate_proposal.note: These are experimental eligibility conditions for the extra correction, not changes to the original contact thresholds, mode switch, ramp, settle or normal-force response. Mode5/6 has no existing explicit transition-complete flag; this gate is a conservative observable proxy, not proof of the legacy transition phase.

proposed_experiment.timing: Count first2s from the first original core Force step after reset, not from total simulation time or start of the2s Position approach. Reset auxiliary counters on existing core reset/new trajectory; after force request withdrawal or contact loss, require fresh stability before any re-enable.
proposed_experiment.preferred_Isaac_connection: The existing constructor injection in a study-private probe can wrap each original core. The wrapper step returns corrected first3 values before action.py673-704 existing command and IK checks. Bind term/env_id gate inputs after gym.make; reset mirrors original core reset exactly.
proposed_experiment.possible_future_ROS_connection: For modes5/6 only, a private sidecar/wrapper around mode3_force_core_->step inside execute_force_control after line317 and before output-to-pose/IK at318-338, with original spatial fault branch and guards retained. This requires later explicit implementation review; do not add correction after IK or change normal transition branch.
proposed_experiment.fault_contact_loss_behavior: Fault branch must bypass correction and retain existing hold/reset. Contact-loss/force-release ticks must return the original unmodified core output, with the original precontact/NAF switch untouched; clear only wrapper correction/timers. Switching off may expose a tangential command drop up to the correction limit, so log and reject discontinuity violations rather than changing original guards or reset state to hide them.
known_limits: Post-core corrected Cartesian command is not written to core command_pose_internal_; the normal NAF previous-command state remains that of the original core. This is an outer-loop experimental variant and requires stability checks.

For identical replayed inputs the original core state/output can be preserved exactly. In closed-loop physics, changed tangential motion may change measured force/pose and thereby original switching event times; unchanged source alone cannot prove unchanged physical transition behavior.
Do not enable corrections during first2s or initial unstable contact; CPU prefix identity and headless entry traces must demonstrate this.
A nominal Mode5/6 success does not establish ROS equivalence or normal-axis physical force invariance.
required_before_GPU_tests: Replay identical no-contact, threshold-boundary, Force request, stable-contact, contact-loss, force-release, fault and reset sequences through original core and wrapper; before eligibility and on loss/fault output24values must match original exactly.
Original core receives identical step arguments and call counts; validate subsequent raw outputs under identical replay inputs to detect accidental state writes.
Correction dot instantaneous TCP normal approximately0 to numerical tolerance, norm<=1.5mm, orientations andMDK unchanged; gain0 is exact original path.
Gate activation is later than2s of Force and.5s uninterrupted18..22N; approach duration/mode-ACK/ramp/reset code hashes remain unchanged.
Contact loss/release correction removal and reacquisition obey existing command/IK limits without suppressing faults.
proposed_experiment.paired_physics_design: Separate controller0/controller1 x constant Mode6/reference9.623actor at identical nominal scene and seeds. Compare actor improvement to Mode6 under the SAME controller and separately report controller-only gains, force errors, tracking, processing time, completion and faults. Use new contract/provenance; do not reinterpret existingfixed-controller results.
proposed_experiment.gate_input_timing_caution: Isaac updates safety_shield_active via _update_safety_status at action.py704, after the core call at664. A closure reading this field during step may see the previous tick. Derive current-tick overload/tracking eligibility from the same current wrench/reference/measured inputs and unchanged cfg thresholds(1.6x force,10mm tracking), or explicitly pass current locals in an isolated harness. Pre-core hard-fault branches already skip step; post-core command/IK faults invoke existing reset.
